amendment: add F_{oclr,cpfr}8_{G,L}_pt and F_{oclr,cpfr}4_G_pt: same views + one positive point at the flow-carried centre. Units already recorded (shard 0) get these generators in a separate stage-1b pass (same code, `diag1b`), so every unit has every generator on its coabs frames. consequence_disclosed: point-prompted candidates force presence, so their raw false-positive rate on GT-empty frames is ~100%; the stage-1 FP criterion is therefore evaluated after the REP-fitted ranker/threshold as pre-registered, not on raw presence.
